auditor_profile.name: Marcus Vance
auditor_profile.title: Lead ISO 27001 & SOC 2 Lead Auditor
auditor_profile.audit_style: Strict technical verification with focus on operational habits
known_habits: Always requests raw access review logs for active engineering staff and terminated employees.
Thoroughly inspects vendor risk assessment matrices and third-party SOC 2 reports.
Performs deep technical sampling on AWS RDS manual and automated snapshots to verify backup encryption.

audits.summary: Overall adequate control environment, but flagged unencrypted RDS snapshots and delayed quarterly access reviews.
Noted recurring issue with unencrypted database snapshots in staging environments and incomplete vendor assessments.
High risk finding issued for overdue privileged IAM access review (#AUD-402) and open unencrypted snapshot risks.
